title_o: Temporal selection is suppressed, delayed, and diffused during the attentional blink.
verdict_reason: The xlsx the audit script loads (osf.io/5fdvw) holds the replication's 720 cell values (12 subjects x 60 cells) with all four variables; a full-factorial OLS ANOVA gives the 3-way interaction F(18,660)=12.98, partial eta2=.261, matching the table.

data_files.notes: Replication block in columns G-K (temporal selection, efficacy 3 levels, latency 2, precision 10, subject 12); original Vul et al block in A-E. Header on row 5.
Old Mac CR line endings; same content as xlsx
Listed only: 146 entries, per-subject .mat raw files plus Matlab analysis code; the xlsx is the aggregated input

key_test.test: between-subjects 3-way ANOVA lm(temporal.selection ~ efficacy*latency*precision), car::Anova type II, row 7 = 3-way interaction; mirrors Matlab anovan 'full'

statistic_reported.p: 1e-12 (table placeholder for a very small p)

recompute.method: python recomputation (statsmodels OLS + anova_lm type 2 and 3; same F for the 3-way term)

obstacles: The analysed file is an aggregated spreadsheet, not trial-level data; the raw .mat files need Matlab to rebuild it
The ANOVA ignores the repeated-measures structure (subject not in the model), as the original did; a reproducer who 'corrects' this gets a different F
Script needs xlsx, car, heplots packages
